[EN] Amani hold a healthy respect for crafting because it binds the wearer to the source.

Too many things are forgotten because they are acquired, not earned.
[ES] Los Amani guardan un profundo respeto por la artesanía porque vincula a quien la lleva con la fuente.

Demasiadas cosas se olvidan porque se adquieren, no se ganan.
